messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — usage rail compact view. when acct scope is chosen should we show a single org sparkline + project peek pills, or keep full project rows? also customers hit support about project sums not matching invoices.
Rohan (Design): vote: org sparkline by default + up to 4 project peek pills (muted strokes). pills reveal on hover/expand. add a small "View invoice mapping" link in the rail header. keeps canvas tidy.
Tess (Frontend): agreed on default condense. mobile perf is real — don't render 12 sparklines at load. lazy-load project series on expand. limit pills width, show "+N" overflow.
Diego (Data): visual/aggregation note: use sum for spend; show tokens as absolute + relative change (e.g., 12.3k ▲4.2%). for sparklines we can offer an optional 7-day MA to smooth noise. avoid stacked area with many lines.
Ian (Billing): invoice mismatch often from credits, proration, and cross-account allocations. modal should explain: time window, credits/adjustments, rounding, and allocation rules. include link to raw invoice CSV.
Nina (Support): customers phrase it as "project totals don't equal my invoice" — recommend modal copy: "Why totals differ: invoices include credits, adjustments, and billing windows. Click to see line-item mapping." also add FAQ blurb for release.
Rohan (Design): microcopy options for denom header: A) "Tokens billed" (tooltip: "Billing units for requests + responses") B) "Billing units (tokens)" C) "Tokens — invoice units" I'm leaning A + short tooltip.
Tess (Frontend): aria/keyboard nits: sparklines need aria-labels like: `aria-label=\"Org spend sparkline — last: $4,120 — min: $1,023 — max: $7,200\"`. tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and focusable.
Diego (Data): UX note: show an inline reconciler peek on hover of project pill — tiny popover with project spend vs invoice-linked amount, with a "View mapping" CTA. keeps context.
Ian (Billing): backend note: we'll need an endpoint to return invoice_mapping for visible projects; can paginate. latency caveat: generating mapping is heavier — cache for 24h.
Maya (PM): decisions for next sprint: 1) Default: condensed org sparkline + up to 4 project peek pills (muted). 2) "Expand projects" fetches per-project sparklines. 3) Add "View invoice mapping" link in rail header + reconciler popover on pills. 4) Token header text: "Tokens billed" + tooltip: "Billing units for requests and responses; see invoice mapping for details." 5) Accessibility: aria-labels + keyboard-focusable tooltips. 6) Backend: invoice_mapping endpoint + cached responses.
Nina (Support): will draft the modal copy + FAQ paragraph.
Rohan (Design): I'll update mocks and supply color tokens that meet 4.5:1. also add micro-animations for expand.
Tess (Frontend): impl estimate: 4 dev days (rail + lazy load + popover) + 1 QA day. I'll make a ticket: FE-4987.
Ian (Billing): backend estimate: 3 dev days to expose mapping + caching.
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: staging/ui-billing-compact-2024-11-12 02:00 UTC :rocket:
Maya (PM): thanks everyone — I'll add acceptance criteria to the ticket and loop in release notes. sync on Monday for final review.
